description: Domain-partitioned variant of Adapt: registered vocabulary and intents are grouped by skill_id into a per-skill IntentDeterminationEngine per language; inference runs every per-skill engine and returns the global argmax. Same distribution and confidence gate as adapt-medium, registered under a separate opm.pipeline entry point (DomainAdaptPipeline in ovos_adapt/opm.py).
notes: Single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate; per-plugin config keeps the same documented thresholds as adapt-medium. This variant is parallel (every domain engine scores, then argmax), not gated two-stage routing. Hypothesis: should improve precision over the flat pipeline on large multi-domain intent sets by keeping decision boundaries local to each skill's vocabulary, and be roughly neutral on small single-domain sets.
